default.install: if [ "${PLOINKY_RUNTIME:-}" = "bwrap" ] || [ "${PLOINKY_RUNTIME:-}" = "seatbelt" ]; then command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: git not found on host.
